title: pvWriteTIFFWriter
body:
## pvWriteTIFFWriter

Explicit-export writer that saves image data (vtkImageData) as TIFF. vtkTIFFWriter accepts unsigned char, unsigned short or float scalars, so unlike PNG it can store 32-bit floating-point fields such as a sampled temperature image. Scalars selects which point array becomes the image values. Publication uses the pixels contract: the TIFF is read back and dimensions, components and values are compared; coordinates and other arrays are not preserved.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Double-precision and other integer types are rejected by the native writer; convert the array to float (or 8/16-bit unsigned) upstream.
- Name the array in Scalars; otherwise ParaView decides which array is written.
- An earlier catalogue run (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json, writerQualification) failed on a small serial fixture with default options: pixel values changed beyond tolerance (tolerance 0); no current native acceptance check is recorded, so verify the file in the receiving tool.

Native constructor: `TIFFWriter`. Identity: `writers/TIFFWriter`. Role: `writer`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Connect upstream object to `Input` | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Scalars` | This property contains the name of the scalar array to be saved. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Output publication contract:

```json
{
  "comparison": "pixels",
  "extensions": [
    "tiff"
  ],
  "filenames": "managed output directory",
  "losses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ],
  "qualification": "requires fixture",
  "time": "one scheduled state"
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "explicit exports with semantic readback",
  "outputPorts": 0,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `scenes[].exports`; writers cannot be graph nodes. The main data input is `node`; non-data ports go in `resources`.

```json
{
  "id": "exportResult",
  "node": "DATA_NODE",
  "writer": "pvWriteTIFFWriter",
  "acceptLosses": [
    "coordinates",
    "fields"
  ]
}
```
